title: Login button unresponsive on mobile Safari
description: On iPhone Safari, tapping the Login button after entering valid credentials does nothing. The form remains visible and no authentication request is sent.

title: Checkout crashes when cart total exceeds $10,000
description: The checkout service raises an unhandled validation exception when an order total is greater than 10000 USD, leaving the customer unable to complete payment.

title: Password reset email arrives without a reset link
description: Password reset notifications sent to Outlook recipients contain the template text but omit the one-time reset URL.

title: Order history page returns 500 for archived customers
description: Opening order history for customers migrated from the legacy archive produces a 500 response from the order-history API.

title: Product image carousel overlaps Add to Cart button
description: At tablet widths, the product gallery carousel extends over the Add to Cart button on the product detail page.

title: Refund API creates duplicate refund after retry
description: A timed-out refund request retried by the client can create two refund records because the API does not enforce the idempotency key.

title: Search filters are cleared when navigating back
description: Selecting category and price filters, opening a product, and using the browser back button clears all active search filters.

title: Inventory reservation is not released after payment failure
description: When card authorization fails at checkout, the inventory reservation persists for fifteen minutes and makes the item unavailable to other customers.

title: CSV export reports success but downloads an empty file
description: The analytics export job completes and displays a success toast, but the downloaded CSV contains headers only for reports with more than 5000 rows.
